why: ARES lists Look AI Ventures SICAV, a.s. (IČO 17604087) and the lookai.vc footer names the same entity as the fund acting for the Look AI Ventures I Subfund.
Look AI Ventures is named among backers of Embodied AI's first funding round, announced mid/late September 2026 (lookai.vc news item dated 22 Sep 2026; other report 16 Sep 2026).
Tech.eu (30 June 2026) says the Lucida AI seed round was led by Velocity Capital with participation from Next Tier Ventures, Look AI Ventures and others.
lookai.vc lists a 23 July 2026 news item on Look AI Ventures investing in Sodex Innovations' EUR 4M round, and the round itself took place 13 July 2026 (raising.fi).
Raising.fi states the Sodex Innovations round took place on 13 July 2026, led by Capmont Technology, with Look AI Ventures joining as a new investor.

ARES shows ZAKA VC I, osoba rizikového kapitálu, a.s. (IČO 21514992), formed 25 Apr 2024 just before ZAKA VC Fund I launched (June/July 2024); name matches the brand and fund, though no source states the IČO explicitly.

Sources say ZAKA VC Fund I (EUR 15M target) started with a EUR 10.5M first closing in mid-2024, so EUR 10.5M is a real first-close amount; note the firm's website now shows an unlabelled 'current fund size 17M' and I found no later close announcement.
ParcelBio's USD 13M seed (announced 7 May 2026) was led by Breyer Capital with participation from ZAKA VC among others.
EIN Presswire release of 7 January 2026 announces an investment in DeepSeq.AI from ZAKA VC together with Illumina Ventures.
EUR 15M is only the Fund I target size; the source says the fund is 'sized at EUR 15 million' but starting with a EUR 10.5 million first closing, so only EUR 10.5M was actually raised.

ARES lists Rockaway Ventures a.s. (IČO 06387136, Generála Píky 430/26, Praha 6, formed 2017), a Rockaway-group company carrying the investor's exact name and sharing an address with sibling Rockaway entities, though its exact role (management/holding) is not stated.
The Sept 2021 cc.cz article only lists Productboard among older investments; Rockaway Capital first invested in 2015 (USD 400K) and joined the USD 10M extension in Feb 2019, not a round in Sept 2021.
The 23 Sep 2021 cc.cz article says the new Rockaway Ventures Fund began investing with Lingvist and the German Vivere (its second investment).
Lupa.cz (19 Feb 2014) reports Brand Embassy received almost USD 1M from Spread Capital and Rockaway Capital ([osoba], the Rockaway group predecessor of Rockaway Ventures).
The May 2025 tech.eu article about the fund close merely names Gjirafa as a notable past investment; Rockaway's Gjirafa rounds were 2016 and March 2019 (Series B) and I found no 2025 round.
Brand Embassy is only mentioned in the Sept 2021 article as an older investment; Rockaway Capital's actual investment was announced in Feb 2014.
Nordic9 (1 March 2026) headlines 'Float secured seed investment from Rockaway Ventures and EIFO' (investor field lists Rockaway Capital).

Rockaway Ventures II closed at nearly EUR 55M (May 2025) and the first Rockaway Ventures Fund held a second close at EUR 40M (Nov 2022, EUR 100M target, third close of EUR 60-70M only planned), so the sum of actually closed amounts is about EUR 95M; no later final close found.

Rockaway Ventures co-led Apaleo's Series A extension announced 1 March 2023 and joined its EUR 20M round of 3 Dec 2024 as an existing investor; the May 2025 fund-close article only names Apaleo as a past investment.
EUR 55M counts only Rockaway Ventures II and omits the earlier Rockaway Ventures Fund, which had a closed EUR 40M (second close, Nov 2022), a gap of more than 20 % of the total.
Cc.cz (4 Feb 2019) reports Productboard's additional USD 10M round with all existing investors including Credo Ventures, Reflex Capital and Rockaway Capital.
TechCrunch (25 March 2019) reports Gjirafa raised a USD 6.7M Series B from Rockaway Capital (the Rockaway group's earlier name for its venture arm).
Lupa.cz (13 Feb 2026) reports Czech investors from Rockaway Ventures entered Apptronik in its Series A extension of USD 520M announced that month.
ARES lists Czech Founders Ventures s.r.o., osoba rizikového kapitálu (IČO 17051835, formed April 2022) and the czechfounders.vc footer reads '© Czech Founders Ventures s.r.o.'.
Cc.cz (17 Sep 2025) reports Lemondia's EUR 300K pre-seed round from Czech Founders VC and Nextech Ventures.
Cc.cz (14 Jan 2026) reports Maxfusion obtained a EUR 350K investment from Czech Founders VC.

Cc.cz (7 Sep 2022) says the 45 founder contributors together put in EUR 10 million (about CZK 250M) after doubling the EUR 5M target, with the final top-up completed a month earlier, so the amount is raised rather than a target.
Lupa.cz (9 June 2026) reports Merchantee's CZK 30M round led by Reflex Capital with Czech Founders VC and Lighthouse Ventures participating.
